items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So Kirby, being the nice man that he was, he said, look, you're here now, so you might as well stay. So they put me to work in the band as the seventh man, and I played tenor.

ctx.x: And no way I can play that music, you know. But I'm game enough. I'm going to give it a try, but I know it's

impossible, and to my good fortune, when I got into Baltimore, Maryland, they were working at a cabaret there, and they had made up. So Kirby, being the nice man that he was, he said, look, you're here now, so you might as well stay. So they put me to work in the band as the seventh man, and I played tenor.

Now I didn't have any music, and I'm up there trying to fake a fourth part to the Kirby band. Can you imagine that? All of the music they were playing -- and in the meantime Charlie Shavers and myself was taking the parts and deciphering them and trying to make a fourth part, --
